history.perspective: Secure storage of the sync recovery secret - the backup-export path, the last unchecked exit
history.outcome: CLEAN, genuinely new angle: traced whether the app's own backup export could leak the plaintext secret into a shared file. Confirmed excluded unconditionally by a shared core predicate, already tested at both layers. Loop's stated 100-iteration ceiling reached; batch 10 closed out here.

history.perspective: Android hardware back-button, live on a real device for the first time (B9 revisited)
history.outcome: CLEAN, live-verified for the first time via a real Android emulator (QA_Pixel6): correct pop/switch-to-home/exit pattern at three navigation depths, confirmed via adb keyevent + dumpsys. Previously only verified by reading source.

history.perspective: Kill-and-restore state integrity, a real process kill instead of a code-only argument (B13 revisited)
history.outcome: CLEAN, live-verified via a genuine adb am kill (confirmed dead via pidof, not just backgrounded). Reading-progress data survived intact; exact in-stack screen not restored, which is standard Android behavior, not a regression.

history.perspective: Deep link handling including malformed links, live on a real device (B10 revisited)
history.outcome: GAP FOUND AND FIXED: a malformed surah/* deep link left the header showing the previous, successfully-loaded surah's title instead of clearing it, because SurahReaderScreen.tsx's header-setting useLayoutEffect never ran on the error path. Fixed by adding an explicit error branch; live re-verified the exact repro is clean after the fix. Found only because a live screenshot was compared, not just a crash/no-crash check.
